AI Overview
Bucket Smash is a casual arcade destruction and resource-management game where you control a heavy demolition machine equipped with a spinning circular saw to tear down brick walls. 
Core Gameplay & Mechanics
Saw & Crusher: You drag your mouse or touch controls to guide the circular saw through brick structures. Broken bricks fall into a crusher and instantly convert into in-game coins. 
Fuel Management: Your machine runs on a strict fuel gauge that depletes while the saw is active. A run ends when the fuel tank empties or the wall is completely destroyed. 
Physics & Strategy: Cutting load-bearing foundations causes massive structural collapses, saving fuel and earning bonus coins faster than cutting bricks at random. 
Upgrades & Progression: You spend earned coins to upgrade your machine's fuel capacity, saw power, saw size, and reach/length. Advanced stages feature a Prestige system to reset progress in exchange for permanent upgrades. 
You can play the game directly in a web browser on platforms like A-Z Games or 1Games
